description: Wave 4b: pack hot reload. The gateway watches the supervisor-style pack manifest (a per-session copy of olife_client + olife_proto) and sends client.PacksChanged after Welcome and on every change. Change 1: modules/hot/rev.lua (rev 2) -> bots download it, materialize the pack in world:content and apply it LIVE (no reopen). Change 2: scripts/world.lua (world script, not live) -> bots download, Bye, app.reopen_world() (pack now loaded from world:content/olife_client), reconnect with a fresh ticket; replication consistent across it.
